import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp/t')
import main
from harness import *
P=main.parse_uri; S=main.parse_sip; T=main.parse_tel

fails=[]
def eq(got,want,label):
    if got!=want:
        fails.append((label,got,want)); print("FAIL",label,"got",repr(got),"want",repr(want))

# valid SIP canonicalizations
eq(S("sip:a@b.c"),"sip:a@b.c","simple")
eq(S("SIP:a@b.c"),"sip:a@b.c","upper scheme")
eq(S("SiPs:a@b.c"),"sips:a@b.c","sips upper")
eq(S("sip:a@B.c"),"sip:a@b.c","host lower")
eq(S("sip:%61@b.c"),"sip:a@b.c","escaped user")
eq(S("sip:a%2db@b.c"),None,"escaped hyphen -> '-' is allowed")  # '-' in USER_CHARS -> valid
eq(S("sip:a%2Db@b.c"),"sip:a-b@b.c","escaped hyphen uppercase hex")
eq(S("sip:a@b.c:5060"),"sip:a@b.c:5060","explicit default port")
eq(S("sip:a@b.c:05060"),"sip:a@b.c:5060","port leading zeros")
eq(S("sip:a@b.c:65535"),"sip:a@b.c:65535","port max")
eq(S("sip:a@b.c:65536"),None,"port too big")
eq(S("sip:a@b.c:00000"),None,"port zero")
eq(S("sip:a@b.c:0"),None,"port zero2")
eq(S("sip:a@b.c:123456"),None,"port 6 digits")
eq(S("sip:a@b.c:"),None,"empty port")
eq(S("sip:a@b.c:abc"),None,"port alpha")
eq(S("sip:a@b"),None,"one label")
eq(S("sip:a@b."),None,"trailing dot")
eq(S("sip:a@.b.c"),None,"empty label")
eq(S("sip:a@b..c"),None,"empty label2")
eq(S("sip:a@-b.c"),None,"label starts hyphen")
eq(S("sip:a@b-.c"),None,"label ends hyphen")
eq(S("sip:a@b.c-"),None,"final ends hyphen")
eq(S("sip:a@1b.c"),"sip:a@1b.c","digit-leading non-final label")
eq(S("sip:a@b.1c"),None,"final label starts digit")
eq(S("sip:a@b.c_"),None,"underscore")
eq(S("sip:a@b_c.d"),None,"underscore label")
eq(S("sip:a@"+"x"*253),"sip:a@"+"x"*253,"host 253")
eq(S("sip:a@"+"x"*254),None,"host 254")
eq(S("sip:a@"+"x"*63+"."+"y"*63+"."+"z"*63+"."+"w"*62),None,"host 255")
eq(S("sip:"+"a"*64+"@b.c"),"sip:"+"a"*64+"@b.c","user 64")
eq(S("sip:"+"a"*65+"@b.c"),None,"user 65")
eq(S("sip:@b.c"),None,"empty user")
eq(S("sip:a@"),None,"empty host")
eq(S("sip:a"),None,"no at")
eq(S("sip:a@b.c@d.e"),None,"two at")
eq(S("sip:a:pw@b.c"),None,"password")
eq(S("sip:a@b.c;transport=tcp"),None,"params")
eq(S("sip:a@b.c?X=1"),None,"headers")
eq(S("sip:a@b.c/"),None,"trailing slash")
eq(S("sip:a b@b.c"),None,"space")
eq(S("sip:a@b c.d"),None,"space host")
eq(S("sip:a@b.c%00"),None,"escaped NUL")
eq(S("sip:a@b.c%2f"),None,"escaped slash")
eq(S("sip:a@b.c%25"),None,"escaped percent")
eq(S("sip:a@b.c%41"),"sip:aA@b.c","escaped A")
eq(S("sip:a@b.c%zz"),None,"bad hex escape")
eq(S("sip:a@b.c%4"),None,"short escape")
eq(S("sip:a@b.c%4G"),None,"bad hex escape2")
eq(S("sip:a~b!c$d@b.c"),None,"$ not allowed")
eq(S("sip:a~b!c*d@b.c"),"sip:a~b!c*d@b.c","mark chars")
eq(S("sip:a'b(c)d@b.c"),"sip:a'b(c)d@b.c","parens quote")
eq(S("sip:a_b@b.c"),"sip:a_b@b.c","underscore user")
eq(S("sip:192.168.0.1"),None,"no at ip")
eq(S("sip:a@192.168.0.1"),None,"IP host rejected")
eq(S("sip:a@[::1]"),None,"IP literal")
eq(S("sip:a@xn--bcher-kva.example"),"sip:a@xn--bcher-kva.example","punycode ok")
eq(S("sip:a@b.c:1"),"sip:a@b.c:1","port 1")
eq(S("sip:a@[b.c"),None,"bracket host")
# tel
eq(T("tel:+123"),"tel:+123","tel min")
eq(T("tel:+123456789012345"),"tel:+123456789012345","tel 15")
eq(T("tel:+1234567890123456"),None,"tel 16")
eq(T("TEL:+123"),"tel:+123","tel upper")
eq(T("tel:+1-202-555-0100"),"tel:+12025550100","tel separators")
eq(T("tel:+1.202.555.0100"),"tel:+12025550100","tel dots")
eq(T("tel:+1(202)555-0100"),"tel:+12025550100","tel parens")
eq(T("tel:+1 202"),None,"tel space not separator")
eq(T("tel:123"),None,"tel no plus")
eq(T("tel:+023"),None,"tel leading zero")
eq(T("tel:+12"),None,"tel 2 digits")
eq(T("tel:+"),None,"tel empty")
eq(T("tel:+123;ext=1"),None,"tel ext")
eq(T("tel:+123 "),None,"tel trailing space")
eq(T("tel:+123a"),None,"tel alpha")
eq(P("tel:+123"),"tel:+123","P tel")
eq(P("sip:a@b.c"),"sip:a@b.c","P sip")
eq(P("http://a.b/"),None,"P other scheme")
eq(P("si p:a@b.c"),None,"P space in scheme")
eq(P("sips:a@b.c"),"sips:a@b.c","P sips")
eq(P(""),None,"P empty")
eq(P("sip:a@b.c".upper()),"sip:a@b.c","P upper whole")

# anonymous
eq(P("sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid"),"sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid","anon")
eq(S("sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid:5060"),"sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid:5060","anon port differs")

print()
print("URI FAILURES:", len(fails))
sys.exit(1 if fails else 0)
